The '''Lazerians''' were the native [[Human/Legends|Human]] population of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. Lazerian society was divided into a series of social classes; Royalty, Nobility, Administrators, Military, Merchants, Landowners, Craftsmen, Tradesmen, Laborers, and Rabble. The classes were not rigid, and Lazerians believed that anyone willing to work hard could get what they deserved and rise through the social ranks<ref name="Twin Stars">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref>
